items.title: JetBrains開源Mellum2.1模型，程式修復評測解決率從2%升至47%
items.summary: JetBrains推出開源語言模型Mellum2.1，鎖定程式開發代理與輔助代理，開發者可將模型部署在自己的電腦或企業伺服器。新版主要透過強化學習提升軟體工程能力，搭配相關工具後，能檢視程式碼庫、修改檔案，並執行測試確認修改結果。模型已在Hugging Face釋出，採Apache 2.0授權。

items.title: 微軟2027年4月起淘汰部分檔案API預先驗證網址，開發者須調整權杖驗證
items.summary: 微軟宣布2027年4月1日起，SharePoint Online與OneDrive將開始淘汰部分Microsoft Graph檔案API使用的預先驗證網址（Pre-authenticated URL）。

items.title: 日本三家旅行服務、系統業者爆資料外洩超過千萬
items.summary: 日本三家旅遊服務及系統業者包括旅行訂票比價平臺Adventure、住宿預約系統平臺業者TEMAIRAZU、及旅遊代理業者H.I.S分別公告發生於去年12月及今年9月、10月的資料外洩事件，洩露數上千萬筆客戶資料。

items.title: 蘋果招募由NotebookLM前員工合組的AI podcast App公司Huxe
items.summary: 近日一份公告文件顯示，蘋果於今年春天招募了Google NotebookLM前團隊成員創立的AI podcast App業者Huxe核心成員並取得技術授權。 根據歐盟列出大廠申報的收購清單，蘋果在今年6月向Huxe AI提出員工招募提案，招募了特定員工，並獲得後者智財權的非獨家技術授權。 蘋果描述Huxe開發的是建造個人化音訊內容的手機應用程式。

items.title: 韓國政府資料中心大火後，重訂系統分級與災難復原標準
items.summary: 2025年9月，韓國負責管理政府資訊系統與資料中心的國家資訊資源管理院（NIRS）位於大田的資料中心發生火災，造成709套政府資訊系統受到影響，直到同年12月30日才全面恢復運作，歷時95天。這起事故也暴露韓國政府在資料備份及災難復原方面的不足。

items.title: feat(agents): compact ChatGPT sign-in sessions server-side (remote co…
items.summary: feat(agents): compact ChatGPT sign-in sessions server-side (remote compaction V2) (#168401) Closes #168088. Related: #168164. ## What Problem This Solves With ChatGPT sign-in, every automatic compaction in OpenClaw ran a client-side summary: separate summarization requests with 0 cached tokens, and a lossy text summary in place of the conversation. Codex compacts the same route server-side ("remote compaction V2"): the next normal model request carries a trailing `{"type":"compaction_trigger"}` item, and the provider returns one opaque `compaction` item that stands in for the history. ## Fix - **Request:** automatic compaction on the ChatGPT route (preflight before a turn, and mid-turn between tool rounds) sends V2 as the next normal request, through the same attempt pipeline and native ChatGPT stream, with `compaction_trigger` appended last. Tools, instructions, parameters, cache key and the full input prefix are the turn's own, so the compaction request reads the warm prompt cache. - **Result:** exactly one non-empty `compaction` item is accepted, only after a successful terminal response and never after an abort. Collection resets for each provider attempt. - **Checkpoint:** real user messages are retained newest-first within 64k tokens, plus the item, matching Codex `compact_remote_v2.rs`. Users retained from an earlier window stay eligible, so repeated compactions keep them. - **Fallback:** every fallback to client compaction logs a WARN with its reason. Overflow recovery, `/compact ` and manual `/compact` stay client-side; manual V2 needs session-writer ownership work and is a follow-up. - **Fixed during live testing** (each with a regression that fails on the defect): 1. V2 never ran: the compact request was checked before the async provider adapter dispatched it. 2. V2 ran only in the managed client; real ChatGPT turns use the native stream. V2 now runs there. 3. Replay normalization dropped the checkpoint turn as an empty failed turn, so the next request grew back to full history. It now keeps successful compaction checkpoints; error turns and suppression markers are still dropped. ## User Impact ChatGPT sign-in sessions compact server-side with no extra summarization requests. Compaction reads 87–100% of its input from cache, and later turns stay at about 14–22k input tokens instead of about 91k. `params.responsesCompactEndpoint: false` turns it off. ## Evidence Live, real ChatGPT OAuth login, `openai/gpt-6-astra`, isolated Gateway, synthetic corpus, three facts seeded before compaction. The host was loaded, so wall times are upper bounds. | Compaction | Compaction input / cached / output | Wall | Input before → after | Next user turn input / cached | Recall | |---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:| | Preflight | 90,999 / 73,856 / 885 | 20.2 s | 90,999 → 22,308 | 22,439 / 22,144 | 3/3 | | Mid-turn, first | 91,075 / 82,560 / 575 | 12.3 s | 91,075 → 13,904 | 14,121 / 12,928 | 3/3 | | Mid-turn, second | 76,486 / 58,880 / 716 | 17.4 s | 76,486 → 14,476 | 14,709 / 14,336 | 3/3 | Request parity, compaction request vs the preceding normal turn: | Compaction | Tools | Instruction chars | Input prefix | Cached vs previous input | |---|---|---|---|---:| | Preflight | 6 → 6 | 35,857 → 35,857 | 26/26 items identical | 89.3% | | Mid-turn, first | 6 → 6 | 35,855 → 35,855 | 26/26 items identical | 99.8% | | Mid-turn, second | 6 → 6 | 35,855 → 35,855 | 39/39 items identical | 86.7% | The tool schemas, instructions, parameters and cache-key hashes were identical in all three. The final head sent exactly 3 `compaction_trigger` requests, all HTTP 200, and no client-summary requests. **Client comparison (same route, before this change):** one client compaction of a 117.9k-token session took two summary calls (9,777 input, 0 cached, 961 output, 24.4 s). The next turn read 33,967 input with 12,800 cached. Trigger points were not matched to the V2 runs, so this is a reference, not a head-to-head benchmark. **Tests:** fetch-boundary regressions across the managed and native ChatGPT streams cover: - request parity; - failed, cancelled and incomplete terminal responses; - aborts; - duplicate or empty items; - multilingual retention; - two consecutive persisted compactions; - the async-dispatch case and replay normalization through the real `SessionManager`. Negative controls fail on each defect. tsgo core/src/packages pass; `check-changed` passes. ## Release-landing follow-ups (2026.10.2) - **ClawSweeper P2 fix (budget anchor), commit e9021240:** V2 used to price the outgoing request with the conservative preflight estimator. That estimator counts unchanged instructions twice, because measured usage already includes them. The V2 boundary now uses the same accounting as the mid-turn precheck it replaces: - The shared code is `resolveProjectedRequestPressure`, split out of `checkMidTurnPrecheck`. - The stream guard's request observation now returns the matching measured predecessor. The foreground request is observed before V2 decides, so both price the same anchor. A checkpoint request is then observed again as its own request. - Requests with no anchor keep the conservative estimate. - Regression test: `chatgpt-v2-compaction.test.ts` "prices a matching measured prefix once before deciding to compact". It uses the 15,000-token / 12,000-char / 24,576 numbers from `attempt-midturn-precheck.test.ts`. It fails on the previous head (the boundary throws `MidTurnPrecheckSignal`) and passes now. - Production LOC: +45/-27. Most of that is the function split plus contract comments. - **Test-only fixture fix, commit 018c9bcf:** three Gateway e2e fixtures counted the labeled `OpenClaw runtime context:` carrier as a user turn: `gateway-rpc-chat`, `gateway-provider-review-product-proof` and `gateway-completion-replay`. These fail the same way on `main` (#168843; same fix as #168961). - **Rollback to v2026.10.1:** that release's replay normalization drops the empty, zero-usage V2 checkpoint carrier. The raw transcript is never rewritten, so v2026.10.1 replays the full raw history, and its own client compaction applies if that history is too large. Rollback loses no data; it just loses the provider checkpoint. The stored checkpoint format already shipped in v2026.10.1, and its reader ignores the added optional `outputTokens` (details in the compatibility comment). ### Unrelated failures that also happen on `main` (proof scoped to the tests involved) Both failures reproduce on a clean `origin/main` checkout at `ce5b795128e` with no PR code. Checking out commits around one change shows that both start at 5843d60c (#168539, "route transcript appends through the session actor"): | Test | `5843d60c^` | `5843d60c` | `origin/main` `ce5b795128e` | |---|---|---|---| | `src/agents/embedded-agent-runner.prompt-cache.test.ts` | 4/4 pass | 2 fail (`SqliteTranscriptMutationConflictError` from `appendSessionManagerActor`) | 2 fail | | `test/gateway-steer-fifo.e2e.test.ts` | 7/7 pass | 3 fail (1 model request where 2 are expected) | 3 fail | - #168981 independently reports the prompt-cache failure on clean main. - #169006 (steering diagnostics) landed and did not fix the steer-fifo failures. - CI selects these tests for this PR only through the shared embedded-runner files. Neither failing path is touched here. ### Local proof on the current head All runs below were local and focused on the touched files: - `chatgpt-v2-compaction`: 13/13. - The other affected `src/agents/embedded-agent-runner/run/` unit files: 208/208. These are `attempt-midturn-precheck`, `attempt-prompt-submit.*`, `attempt-stream-*`, `preemptive-compaction*`, `attempt-execution-phase`, `attempt-prompt-preflight` and `attempt-context-guards`. - `agent-runner.runreplyagent.e2e`: 231/231. - The 3 repaired Gateway e2e files: all passed. - `node scripts/check-changed.mjs -- ` exited 0. That run includes `tsgo` for core and core tests. - Codex protocol check (read directly in `../codex`): `codex-rs/core/src/compact_remote_v2_attempt.rs:70-84` and `compact_remote_v2.rs:65,398-450`. ### Unrelated failures on the current head (b3a74050, which merges `origin/main` at `ff6f58a8c32`) The two failures above (prompt-cache and steer-fifo) no longer fail on this head; main has since landed actor-append fixes. Two other unrelated failures remain: 1. **`src/agents/embedded-agent-runner/run.harness-auth-failover.test.ts`** (5 tests, `checks-node-changed-compact-large-4`): - Fails the same way on a clean `origin/main` checkout at `ff6f58a8c32`, and passes at `bdcbb2d8870` (10/10). - `git bisect` names `e63b5a01cf26` as the first bad commit: #168992, "perf(agents): reduce repeated SQLite work during agent preparation". - This PR does not touch native harness auth. 2. **`extensions/codex/src/app-server/run-attempt.steering-settlement.test.ts`** (`checks-node-changed-extensions-bundle-3`, 180s hook timeout): - Also fails on the unrelated PR #169026 (CI run 38137511377). - Passes locally (2/2) on this head, on clean `origin/main` `ff6f58a8c32`, and on this branch merged with that main. - This PR touches no `extensions/codex` files. Two other failures were flaky: `build-artifacts` (`sqlite-sessions-transcripts-flip-proof.built-cli`) and `gateway-completion-replay`. Each passed on rerun, and each passes locally after `pnpm build` on this head. Co-authored-by: roboclaw-bot Co-authored-by: Dallin Romney Co-authored-by: Ayaan Zaidi

items.title: fix: disclose hidden model fallbacks before clearing them (#169511)
items.summary: fix: disclose hidden model fallbacks before clearing them (#169511) ## What Problem This Solves Settings → Models displays only the first fallback, so operators cannot see that choosing **No fallback model** also removes hidden fallbacks. ## User Impact Operators see how many fallbacks follow the displayed model and how many will be removed before choosing no fallbacks. The compact picker and existing save behavior stay unchanged. ## Why This Change Was Made A read-only count uses the existing row description, keeping the picker width unchanged. With multiple fallbacks, the clearing option says **No fallback model (remove all N)**. No chain editor, config, or schema change. Why it was this way: [#134813](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/134813) deliberately replaced the chain editor with a first-fallback picker and defined “No fallback model” as clearing the whole chain; this change preserves that intent and makes its effect visible. No overlap with Pash/Sarah changes. ## Evidence - 38 focused Models page and config-mutation tests pass. The three-fallback case checks the count and explicit removal label, replacement retaining the ordered tail, and clearing the entire chain. - The built Control UI was exercised through an isolated real Gateway with synthetic models and dummy credentials: three configured fallbacks are disclosed; choosing the explicit clear-all option persists no fallbacks. - UI i18n verification/baseline, the full build, the final UI rebuild, and diff checks pass. The build reports its existing 36-vs-35 chat-boot request advisory; no unrelated performance baseline is changed. - Desktop and 390px screenshots inspected. The separate catalog-discovery warning visible in these fixtures is unchanged and outside this repair. - The wrapper import-closure CI failure reproduces unchanged on clean main (16 pass, 1 fail); see the [main reproduction and maintainer override](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/169511#issuecomment-6116382705). The required-job rerun completed: only that failure and its aggregate CI gate remain red; all other selected jobs passed. ### Same three-fallback configuration | Before | After | | --- | --- | | ![Before: hidden fallback chain is not disclosed](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/b3c28058-1af9-42bf-bb49-e06874f7fba7) | ![After: two additional fallbacks are disclosed below the label](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/05f62fa5-4251-4832-ad80-c052b5d66002) | ### Explicit clearing option ![The no-fallback option states that all three models will be removed](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/a39762d8-76ec-4898-bb3a-38d1241b8051) ### 390px layout ![The fallback description and picker remain readable at 390px](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/99ae91c7-3b71-422f-9948-5be9b4eb353e) Merge danger: two-way door; reverting removes the disclosures without changing configuration writes. Blast radius is the Models settings fallback picker; other model selection and failover behavior are unchanged. Co-authored-by: Ayaan Zaidi
